description_en: Queries the priority range of an access control policy for a NAT firewall
description_zh: 查询NAT防火墙访问控制策略优先级生效范围
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-nat-firewall-policy-prior-used --nat-gateway-id ngw-xxxxxx --direction out --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNatFirewallPolicyPriorUsed

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT Gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction of the access control policy.

Valid value:

out: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的流量方向。

取值：

out：内对外流量
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The IP version. Valid value:

4 (default): IPv4
parameters.help_zh:
支持的IP地址版本。取值：

4（默认）：代表IPv4地址
parameters.name: ip_version

End.description_en: The lowest priority of the access control policy
End.description_zh: 访问控制策略生效的优先级最低值

Start.description_en: The highest priority of the access control policy
Start.description_zh: 访问控制策略生效的优先级最高值
